posts.name: Joe Walker
posts.cooked:
You can try manually removing all the i686 packages
sudo dnf remove nss.i686 at-spi2-core.i686 libssh.i686 libtiff.i686 librsvg2.i686
and then doing the upgrade.

or you can try a distro-sync …

sudo dnf distro-sync \
    --refresh \
    --releasever=43 \
    --allowerasing \
    --skip-broken

Have a safe trip

posts.name: Joe Walker
posts.cooked:
To fix the duplicates ..

Run dnf remove --duplicates but received Unknown argument "--duplicates" Ask Fedora
You can achieve the same result with this command: sudo dnf reinstall $(dnf rq --duplicates \ --latest-limit=1 --qf="%{name}\n") See also: Upgrade to 41, "dnf remove --oldinstallonly" doesn't work in dnf5 - #3 by vgaetera

Can you also post
sudo dnf repolist

Thanks
